name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '_45' is dispatch idx 0x45 in the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91 (table entry @ 0x51CA5), a meaningful slot ID, not address residue (fn is at 0x35AB8). '_ch28' is chapter 28 (valid chapter ID 01-30). 'dyn_turn_event' accurately names the dynamic turn-event scheduler behavior and is consistent with sibling handlers 3e/41/43.
purpose: Chapter-28 tile-step handler (dispatch idx 0x45): a dependency-gated dynamic turn-event scheduler that arms a follow-up turn event for the current turn once its prerequisite sentinel scene has fired.
logic_summary: 1-arg cdecl with __CHK(4) stack-frame check. Reads stepping_char_id from [ESP+0x4], indexes data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (stride 0x50). Fires only when all three gates hold: runtime_char[stepping_char_id].team != 0 (non-enemy: npc/player, team encoding 0=enemy 1=npc 2=player, field at +0x06) AND consumed_flags[0x11] == 0 (own slot unconsumed) AND consumed_flags[0x12] != 0 (prereq slot 0x12 already consumed by handler_44/handler_49). When triggered: store data_fd2_battle_turn_counter (8-bit load MOV DL,[0x53BEF]) as a byte into data_fd2_tile_event_data_table_ptr+9 (hook entry 2's turn byte, no +1), then set consumed_flags[0x11]=1 to consume own slot. Disassembly confirms 8-bit move; (uint8) truncation in src is exact.

params.name: stepping_char_id
params.semantics: Tile-step ABI arg: index of the char that stepped the tile. Read from [ESP+0x4], used to index data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr to test the stepping char's team. Passed by the tile-step dispatcher (fd2_handle_tile_event_interaction).
params.reason: Accurately describes the value (stepping char id); no address residue; consistent with sibling tile-step handlers 3b/3c which also name it stepping_char_id.

reads_globals: data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (0x53A45) -- .team field at +0x06 of the indexed runtime_char
data_fd2_tile_event_data_table_ptr (0x53A55) -- base for the +9 hook-entry-2 turn byte store
data_fd2_battle_turn_counter (0x53BEF) -- current battle turn, read as a byte
writes_globals: data_fd2_tile_event_data_table_ptr (0x53A55) -- byte at +9 set to (uint8)turn_counter (arms hook entry 2)
data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr (0x53AD5) -- byte at [0x11] set to 1 (consume own slot)
notes: Comment block (chevt2.c lines 932-960) is accurate, ASCII-clean, and matches verified disassembly: __CHK(4) frame, 3-gate condition (team!=0, flags[0x11]==0, flags[0x12]!=0), 8-bit turn_counter store at data_table+9, consume flags[0x11]=1. No em-dash/non-ASCII in this symbol's block (em-dashes seen elsewhere belong to other handlers; not touched per per-symbol rule). Ghidra decompiler shows struct member as bTeam; src uses .team (types.h +0x06) -- naming difference only, semantics identical, src is source of truth. Name and param both kept; rename (none needed) would be a Stage-2 concern anyway. No callers (dispatch-table-only, xref from 0x51CA5).
